guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.29 to 7.69 (+2593%, z=+305) and its latency-90 and socket count rose with it (z=+171 and z=+41), while no other service shows a comparable shift. The slowest traces (about 1.1 s) do not pass through emailservice, and the logs have no warnings or errors, so the link between the CPU anomaly and the user-facing latency is not confirmed.

proposed_fix.description: Check emailservice CPU limits and throttling and look for a runaway process or a hot loop. If it is saturated, raise the CPU limit or add replicas, and restart the pod only if the CPU stays pegged.
